Privacy notice

Last updated September 22, 2026

This website is designed to provide information about Nabura Labs and help prospective clients start a conversation.

Information you choose to provide

The project inquiry form creates an email draft in your own email application. The website does not transmit or store the form contents automatically. If you send the email, Nabura Labs receives the information you include and uses it to respond to your inquiry and evaluate a potential business relationship.

Technical information

The hosting provider may process routine technical data needed to deliver and secure the website, such as IP address, browser information, request time, and security logs. Nabura Labs does not use advertising cookies or cross-site tracking on this website.

Retention and sharing

Inquiry information is kept only as long as reasonably needed for communication, business records, legal obligations, and dispute prevention. It is not sold. It may be shared with service providers or professional advisers only when reasonably necessary, or when required by law.

Your choices

You may ask about, correct, or request deletion of information you previously sent, subject to legal and recordkeeping requirements.

Contact

For privacy questions, email essam@naburalabs.com.
